rows.scope: Reload copies the package classes from Source; Overwrite=0 keeps classes present in the target; classes owned by another module resource are excluded; copied classes are compiled. Native o1-o4. Export/Load providers and the /checkuptodate flag are native-qualified (a newer target was still replaced). CompileAfter and Flags attributes not assessed.

Uninstall resolves the Copy package in the installing namespace and deletes every class not owned by another module, including classes the load kept (C:D40). Native u1, u2, u4. Mapped classes and projection ordering in %Clean are not assessed.
